evidence.text: Final-year student in a Data Engineering bachelor program with coursework related to AI systems, retrieval and cloud foundations.
A six-month internship involved developing backend components for an AI application and connecting application logic, data retrieval and external model services.
Python was used as the primary language for modular backend logic, document processing, retrieval orchestration and API integration.
The profile lists practical work with relational and document databases, CRUD operations, data flows and basic backend integration.
A retrieval pipeline parsed documents, applied structured chunking, indexed content in a vector database and retrieved source-linked passages.
The document pipeline preserved reusable metadata for source, hierarchy, timestamps and version information to support traceability and later indexing.
The internship evaluated retrieval quality, response latency and model API usage and introduced semantic caching for repeated queries.
The project included database migrations, environment configuration, automated tests, Docker and Docker Compose for repeatable deployment.
The project describes a production-oriented architecture and maintainability goals, but does not explicitly document intermediate SQL, batch ETL, warehouse modeling or data-quality checks.
Customer-facing teaching work required requirement clarification, accessible technical explanations, written instructions and stakeholder communication.
Completed foundation-level courses covering cloud systems, data engineering and machine learning.
